validation_level: Pinned primary-source and static implementation audit only. No installation, generation, rendering, video download or artistic review performed.

projects.name: VisualEDU

data.large_artifact: data.zip is a 135-byte Git LFS pointer advertising 1345395825 bytes. Payload was not fetched or inspected.

projects.pipeline: Solve, retrieve tool/meta prompt, generate Manim, execution repair, one-frame VLM visual feedback.
implementation_gaps: main.py lines 15-16 have unfinished num = and math_problem = assignments; source cannot parse as published.
Imports library and load_img_to_github, whose Python modules are missing.
Machine-specific Windows paths; unbounded execution repair loops.
feedback_visual.py extracts a single frame at floor(total_frames * 3 / 5); main runs one feedback iteration.
requirements.txt is a UTF-16 environment freeze with clip @ file:///D:/DeepL_code/CLIP-main/CLIP-main.

metrics.actual: No complete LPR/FE/AS aggregation/table evaluator found in inspected Python. generate_judge.py judges problem similarity for retrieval. Feedback inspects one image, not temporal explanatory meaning.
metrics.human: Paper describes human and VLM review, but clearly reported human sample/rater counts, agreement data and public rating rows were not found in inspected source. Larger LFS payload remains unverified.

projects.license: No repository LICENSE found; public visibility does not establish a reuse license.
projects.verdict: Not a complete directly executable reproduction. Useful task corpus and retrieval/feedback design; repair entrypoint, missing modules, paths and evaluator explicitly. Do not assume the uninspected LFS payload lacks additional data.

projects.name: ALGOGEN
projects.snapshot_method: 24 selected code/text files fetched via pinned GitHub contents API; per-file SHA256 in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json. Full git tree inventory inspected. Sparse git checkout lazy fetch suffered TLS failures; media blobs not fetched.
projects.disambiguation: algenlab/algogen is the website/demo repo. Its anonymous.4open.science implementation link returns repository_expired; author GitHub algogen_anonymous contains actual pipeline source.

data.missing: No full 200-task experiment manifest or matching baseline comparison results found in source tree.

projects.pipeline: LLM tracker → typed VTA trace → RSL/controller → JSON-schema checked render configuration → deterministic Manim → whole-video VLM AES. Large operation renderer is real implementation.
implementation_gaps: tool_maker_agent.run_and_validate_trace checks JSON object, svl_version 5.0, initial_frame and deltas presence after tracker execution; does not fully validate VTA references/operation parameters or reference algorithm correctness.
Current toolmaker uses DeepSeek-V3.2 and default max-retries 1, differing from paper model set/up-to-3 repair.
run_pipeline tracker subprocess executions lack timeout; reuse of existing trace/video lacks source-hash integrity.
No Manim_direct / Manim_direct_rag / Manim_direct_novta full benchmark drivers or TEA evaluation script found.

metrics.AES: eval/aes_eval_video.py sends full base64 MP4 in video_url to zai-org/GLM-4.6V, parses five 0–20 dimensions: ElementLayout, Attractiveness, LogicFlow, AccuracyDepth, VisualConsistency. Genuine video input, not keywords; comprehension validity not established.
metrics.algorithm_correctness: Paper uses LLM code rubric, not executable reference tests.
metrics.table2_caveat: 599/600 (99.8%) is our trace-generation/JSON success; 165/200 (82.5%) ManimDirect is end-to-end video-render success. Different success events/denominators cannot establish matched video-quality improvement.
metrics.table3: Several minutes per video and differing successful-video sample sizes across arms; does not establish rapid local self-iteration.
metrics.human: No learner comprehension experiment or released human rating rows found; TEA is an automatic rubric.

projects.provider: SiliconFlow API; a signed-in Codex workflow requires an explicit adapter, not credential extraction.
projects.license: No LICENSE in source repo or recognized GitHub license metadata. Paper plans MIT release; that does not establish current code license.
projects.verdict: Strong structural engineering reference and partial implemented baseline. Not complete reproduction of the published 200-task comparisons; supply task manifest, missing comparative drivers/TEA, matched budgets, model pins and reference correctness oracle.

projects.name: ManiBench (nabin2004)

data.note: Rows can overlap/repeat across trials; do not claim 1687 independent examples.

projects.pipeline: Generation with zero-shot/few-shot/CoT/constraint/version-aware prompt strategies; executability, version conflict, alignment and coverage metrics; analysis.py produces current automatic metric LaTeX/CSV/Markdown tables.

metrics.executability: AST/import compatibility plus optional actual timed low-quality Manim render.
metrics.alignment: _detect_event matches event/description words and animation keyword banks as source substrings, with play-context regex fallback. No frame/video inspection or temporal alignment; comments or unused source can satisfy some checks.
metrics.coverage: Regex/API-presence proxies for math annotations, visual mapping, numeric evidence and structure; API appearance does not prove visible explanation.
metrics.human: Specification proposes two reviewers/output, third tie-break and agreement metrics. Pilot table claims 72 GPT-4o/Claude-3.5-Sonnet trials; public automatic result files contain other models. Matching original human annotations/agreement rows were not found.
metrics.table_code: Current automatic result aggregation genuinely exists. Its source proxies differ materially from temporal/human evaluation described in specification.

projects.dependencies: FFmpeg/LaTeX/Pango/pycairo/ManimPango; OpenRouter/Inference.net model APIs require adapter for signed-in Codex.
projects.license: dataset_card.md labels MIT, but no repository LICENSE found. Bundled third-party code/dependencies retain own rights; dataset metadata is not a complete code license audit.
projects.verdict: Useful small task set, generation runner, saved source/results and automatic render/static checks, not a validated video expression oracle. Installation not attempted.

projects.name: ManimBench (NtrpyDev)
projects.pipeline: Operational runner with provider adapters including file_provider for external generated source; static requirements, render checks, sampled-frame sanity, layout probe and optional manual review.

metrics.source: Syntax/MainScene/imports/label literals/sections/suspicious code. Required source terms are advisory in v0.6.0; describing all checks as keyword-only would be inaccurate.
metrics.frame_sanity: Six sampled frames analyze contrast, foreground/edge density, crowded grid cells and connected components. Can detect blank/clutter/clipping, not causal explanatory meaning.
metrics.layout_probe: Runs only after successful local render; imports scene, stubs play/wait, calls construct and inspects final label bounds/overlap. Not full trajectory; official container path is inconclusive.
metrics.inconclusive: Missing visual dependencies/extraction/probe errors may yield inconclusive with passed:true, so passing score can lack visual evidence.
metrics.manual: Pending/pass/partial/fail gallery review and adjusted scores; rubric includes clarity/pacing/faithfulness, but no released validated viewer-comprehension dataset found.
metrics.study: No controlled paper experiment/human-study evidence verified for this operational project.

projects.license: MIT repository LICENSE exists. Transitive dependency licenses not exhaustively audited.
projects.verdict: Most readily usable operational runner of this audited subset, based on static inspection only. Reuse task specs/file_provider/render checks; add full-video review instead of equating capability score with understandability.

recommendation.ready_operational_tasks: NtrpyDev 6 tasks/file_provider or nabin2004 12 tasks. Treat static/render metrics as guards and use separate full-video expression review.
recommendation.structural_reference: ALGOGEN typed state/operation boundary and deterministic renderer, with explicit reproduction gaps.
recommendation.lower_priority: Do not spend first iteration reconstructing VisualEDU until its large artifact and missing components are verified.
recommendation.full_baseline: No candidate here is both a complete released reproduction of its reported experiment and a validated benchmark of viewer understanding.
matched_experiment_requirements: Pin task IDs, source and every repair attempt.
Match generation/repair budgets and success events.
Separate reference/math checks, render sanity and full-video expression/causal-mechanism review.
Record latency/tool cost and include failure cases.
Use human review or independently calibrated VLM; no static-keyword quality substitution.

name_warning: SuienR/ManimBench-v1 / ManimTrainer is a third separate project audited by parent; its 417 tasks must not be confused with NtrpyDev 6 or nabin2004 12.
limitations: Static inspection only, no runtime success claim.
No video downloaded or artistically reviewed.
ALGOGEN selective source snapshot and full tree inventory, not full media checkout.
Declared versions/repo license presence checked, not an exhaustive transitive license audit.
